title: 2011 Irkutsk mass UFO sighting
summary: Jesse Michels tells of 2011 Irkutsk mass UFO sighting, about 2011 at Irkutsk Oblast, Siberia, Russia, and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You see, back in 2011, Russian National Channel 1 aired a report about a supposed mass UFO sighting in the Irkutsk Oblast, a region in Southeastern Siberia.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in 2011 Russia's national television station, Channel One, aired a report on a mass UFO sighting in the Irkutsk region of southeastern Siberia. The report, he says, involved people named Nelly Stepanovna and Sergey Yazev, and he brings it up as a case where many people at once said they saw something unexplained.
